summary: Advanced an existing pull-request CI workflow into an enforced quality gate by requiring the validate-json status check before protected-branch updates.
journal_note: The Arcane Engineer progressed from automated CI validation to enforced merge protection, demonstrating how CI and repository governance combine to prevent known-bad changes from reaching the protected branch.
